(Dhārmika)Subhūti
alias Aśvaghoṣa. a verse of Aśvaghoṣa is quoted under this name by Vasubandhu (Abhikośa III. 59) an. Tibasam translation of Aśvaghośa's work Pañcagatidīpana (Chagatidīpanī in Pāli) an. Saddharmasmṛtyu-pasthānakārikā are given under the name Dhārmika Subhūti.
For the identification see Sylvain Levis: Exore Aśvaghoṣa: II. Aśvaghośa et Dhārmika Subhūti, J.. Vol. 213, July-Dec, 1928, 204-07.
-Daśakuśalakarmapathanirdeśa. Bud. See under the text.
-Saddharmasmṛtyupasthānakārikā. Bud. See under the text.
-Sarvayānālokakaravaibhāṣya. Cordier III. p. 316.
See also under Aśvaghoṣa.
